description: Declared capabilities of the FTFuzz semantic mutator

PRESERVE_REGION.description: Exclude a byte range from mutation

DELETE_REGION.description: Remove all bytes in a range

EMPTY_REGION.description: Replace region content with a minimal placeholder

REMOVE_TOKENS.description: Scan for and remove specific token patterns

FORBID_TOKENS.description: Prevent specific tokens from being inserted

INSERT_TOKEN_IN_REGION.description: Insert tokens only within a grounded scope

DUPLICATE_REGION.description: Copy a region and insert the copy

MOVE_REGION_EARLIER.description: Relocate a region to an earlier offset

EXTEND_AFTER_REGION.description: Append seed self-bytes after a region

FOCUS_RANGE_HAVOC.description: Apply standard havoc within a bounded range

PRESERVE_AWARE_HAVOC.description: Apply havoc while avoiding preserve regions

REJECT_UNSUPPORTED.description: Reject the requested effect — cannot be lowered

REPAIR_CHECKSUM.reason_unsupported: Checksum algorithms are target-specific; not yet implemented

REPAIR_LENGTH_FIELD.reason_unsupported: Length field repair requires format-specific knowledge; token-level repair is not generic

focus_range.check: boundary_evidence or token_scan provides byte range

focus_range_optional.check: try to locate scope; if not found, use whole-seed fallback

preserve_range.check: reachability_region or declaration_region evidence provides range

byte_window.check: surrounding bytes exist around evidence token positions

boundary_evidence.check: opening and closing delimiters are identifiable
